summary: Frontend-only RETEST of the two previously P0-blocked 2FA flows (ARGUS NOC, UI IT) after the App.js/2FA-pages fixes. Both flows now PASS end-to-end via public preview URL. (1) ENROLLMENT: login admin info@86bit.it -> app redirects to /2fa-setup, QR ('2fa-qr') and copyable secret ('2fa-copy-secret' = WEQEYNF53JJTASIMEIRNPXKTKVUN3RYG) rendered; TOTP computed with stdlib hmac/hashlib was accepted on the FIRST attempt; POST /api/auth/confirm-2fa fired WITH Authorization header and returned 200; app landed on the authenticated dashboard (/) with GET /api/auth/me 200, no 403 'Not authenticated'. (2) LOGIN WITH 2FA ACTIVE: fresh login -> redirect to /2fa, code entered in '2fa-code-input', POST /api/auth/verify-2fa sent WITH Authorization and returned 200, dashboard loaded. (3) IDEMPOTENCY: exactly 1 POST /api/auth/setup-2fa on /2fa-setup mount (useRef guard works) and the displayed secret matched the one validated server-side. The intermediate 403 on GET /api/auth/me (restricted 2FA-pending token) no longer triggers logout - token is preserved as intended. Admin account restored to clean 'enroll required' state at the end (two_factor_enabled=false, totp_secret/totp_secret_pending unset). Backend not re-tested (already 9/9 in iteration_103).

issues: Success toasts ('2FA attivato con successo' / 'Verifica completata') are effectively invisible: both pages call window.location.reload() immediately after navigate(), destroying the toast before the user can read it. Cosmetic only - navigation and auth succeed. Consider dropping the reload or delaying it ~1.2s.

action_items: Optional (cosmetic): avoid window.location.reload() right after navigate() in TwoFactorSetupPage.js / TwoFactorPage.js so the success toast is visible.
critical_code_review_comments: TwoFactorSetupPage/TwoFactorPage read the token directly from localStorage instead of the AuthProvider context - works, but duplicates auth logic; consider a shared authHeader() helper exported from App.js.
Expected 403 on GET /api/auth/me with a 2FA-pending token pollutes the browser console with a red network error; a dedicated non-403 signal (e.g. 200 + {requires_2fa:true}) would be cleaner.

context_for_next_testing_agent: 2FA E2E is green. Admin is back in 'enroll required' state, so ANY future login as admin must go through /2fa-setup first (setup-2fa -> confirm-2fa with a stdlib-computed TOTP). Login rate limit is 10/5min per IP: only 2 logins were consumed in this run. Use data-testid selectors on the login page ('login-email-input', 'login-password-input', 'login-submit-btn') - generic input[type=password]/button[type=submit] selectors failed to trigger submit in the first attempt. Both 2FA pages navigate then window.location.reload(), so wait ~6-7s after confirm/verify before asserting dashboard content.
rca_of_the_issue: Previous P0 (iteration_103) root cause - AuthProvider.fetchUser() called logout() on the expected 403 from GET /api/auth/me with the restricted 2FA-pending token, wiping noc_token so confirm-2fa/verify-2fa were sent unauthenticated. Fix verified: 403 no longer logs out, and both 2FA pages attach the Authorization header explicitly; TwoFactorSetupPage uses a useRef guard so setup-2fa runs once (no secret rotation between QR render and code validation).
